<translate>
'''Emperor's Death Beam''' is Frieza's rapid-fire version of the Death Beam: instead of a single laser, it fires a chain of 10 death beams in quick succession. It is an instant Laser attack, so it needs no charging.
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it ==

[[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza|Frieza]] teaches Emperor's Death Beam for '''5,000 TP'''. He only trains characters with Evil alignment (40 or lower). Like every ki technique, it needs [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], an empty main hand and at least 5% Power Release, and it must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works ==

Press the slot key and the attack fires immediately (Laser attacks are instant). It shoots a rapid chain of '''10 death beams''':

* the first beam deals full damage, with a damage multiplier of ×1.25;
* each follow-up shot deals 20% of the first one's damage.
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades ==

As a Laser attack, it gains experience when it hits and can upgrade its damage, speed, armor penetration and cooldown. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes ==

* The plain '''Death Beam''' (Laser, ×0.75, 2,500 TP) is taught by Frieza and Cell. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Attacks|Ki Attacks]].
* Lasers are small attacks: if they run into a firing beam (Wave or Beam type), they are destroyed instead of clashing, unless the beam belongs to an ally. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Beam Clash|Beam Clash]].
</translate>
